name: Snap Cards Match
tagline: A fast-paced card-matching game across Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
description:
A cross-platform memory game where players flip cards, find matching pairs, and chase their best score — with a tailored experience on every Apple device.

• Multiple game modes — Classic, Time Attack, Sudden Death, and Zen — across five difficulty levels.
• Six symbol themes plus seasonal themes that activate automatically, with customizable card backs.
• A streamlined Apple Watch build with Digital Crown navigation and haptic feedback on every flip and match.
• Quality-of-life touches: hints, undo, and an optional countdown timer.
• Game Center leaderboards, a bonus-point streak system, and Family Sharing support.

name: Streak Bubble
tagline: Turn your goals into streaks you actually want to keep — with friends who hold you to it.
description:
A Flutter habit-tracking app that pairs streak-building with real social accountability, so momentum comes from both progress and the friends watching your back.

• Flexible goals — daily, weekly, custom, and location-based habits completed with a single tap.
• Accountability friends who get notified when you miss, plus a workout buddy to verify completions.
• Streak recovery to bounce back from a missed day instead of losing the whole chain.
• A Streak Album, social feed, group challenges, and milestone celebrations (3 to 365 days).
• Apple Watch support, private goals, and a Plus tier unlocking unlimited friends, instant recovery, and exclusive Watch features.

name: Sentential
tagline: Learn a language by mastering the part that matters most — making sentences.
description:
A Flutter language-learning app that goes beyond memorizing words and phrases to teach the heart of any language: building correct, natural-sounding sentences.

• Sentence-first learning that grounds grammar and structure in real, usable sentences.
• A frictionless start — a simple UI with no signup, so learners can dive in immediately.
• Beginner-friendly reading content that scales up to more complex structures at the learner's own pace.
• Quizzes that reinforce each concept and surface progress in real time.
• Designed to take learners from first words to confident, everyday conversation.

name: Oye Cab
tagline: A taxi-booking app that lets you reserve rides up to a week in advance.
description:
A Flutter taxi-booking app built to make travel planning seamless and stress-free, letting riders lock in a dependable ride days ahead or hail one on the spot.

• Advance booking — reserve rides up to seven days ahead for guaranteed availability.
• Fixed-fare pricing with no surge, so the price you see is the price you pay.
• A clean, mobile-first UI that gets riders booked in just a few taps.
• Real-time tracking of the assigned taxi from booking through to drop-off.
• Multiple secure payment options for fast, flexible checkout.

name: TrackZone — Smart Ends
tagline: Smart-bin sensors and camera AI for the waste and recycling industry.
description:
A Flutter field app for the smart waste and recycling industry, putting real-time bin intelligence and incident reporting in the hands of collection crews. Built for operations in Belgium and expanding across Europe.

• Real-time bin monitoring of exact locations and fill levels, helping crews plan efficient routes and prevent overflow.
• Turn-by-turn navigation to any bin via integrated HERE Maps SDK, optimizing collection routes and saving time.
• On-the-spot incident reporting with photos, GPS, and time stamps sent straight to the back office for fast resolution.
• Smart-bin sensor and camera-AI integration for contamination detection and ESG reporting.
• Designed to make field technicians and waste-collection staff measurably more efficient on every route.

name: TwoDos
tagline: A minimalist, private to-do app for two — shared lists with real-time sync.
description:
A Flutter productivity app for the Mac built around a simple idea: task management is better when it's shared with exactly one person, kept private and clutter-free.

• Shared collections that live exclusively between you and your chosen partner.
• Real-time collaboration — both people see task updates the moment they happen.
• Quick sign-in with existing email credentials, no new account to set up.
• Automatic sorting that separates completed items so remaining work stays front and center.
• A deliberately minimal, distraction-free interface — and always free to use.

name: Rosterify
tagline: A Flutter app for staff shift scheduling and team rostering.
description:
A cross-platform Flutter app for managing staff shifts and team rosters with a clean, mobile-first interface.

• Built shift scheduling, roster management, and availability tracking in Flutter.
• Backed by Firebase for authentication and real-time data sync across devices.
• Designed an intuitive Material UI experience optimized for quick day-to-day use.

name: Khata at Home
tagline: Take control of your Khata, take control of your life.
description:
A cross-platform ledger and expense-tracking app built in Flutter.

• Offline-first sync so records stay available without a connection.
• Multi-currency entries for flexible bookkeeping.
• Lightweight local storage with SQLite for fast, reliable access.
• Clean, approachable Material UI designed for everyday personal finance.

name: XiltriX
tagline: Cloud SaaS for real-time lab environment monitoring and sensor data analytics.
description:
A cloud-based SaaS platform for real-time lab environment monitoring and sensor data analytics.

• Built with React, Node.js, Material-UI, and AWS, supporting continuous environmental tracking via smart sensor integrations.
• Led frontend interface design with a focus on hierarchical data handling, real-time updates, and developer-friendly UX patterns.
• Developed a custom logging system to track user interactions and feature usage, improving operational visibility.
• Structured the UI for scalability and usability, improving data comprehension for scientific and administrative users.

name: IshowroomPro
tagline: A CMS powering dynamic digital showrooms across mobile and web.
description:
A content management platform powering dynamic digital showrooms across mobile and web.

• Built frontends in Vue.js and Ionic, and backend services in Node.js and Express.
• Designed and containerized microservices with Docker, deployed on Kubernetes for seamless scalability.
• Ran full E2E testing across platforms for consistent iOS and Android behavior.
• Focused on performance, maintainability, and modular design for faster partner onboarding and feature rollout.

name: Mastery (MasterMind)
tagline: A logistics app helping long-haul drivers with route optimization, safety, and compliance.
description:
A logistics-focused mobile solution built in React Native to support long-haul drivers with route optimization, safety, and compliance.

• Built a React Native app for drivers on long routes, designed to boost efficiency and safety.
• Delivered real-time route guidance, live ETAs, and integration with MasterMind's cloud-based TMS for load and navigation data.
• Designed an offline-first architecture for uninterrupted access to critical route data in low-connectivity areas.
• Optimized performance for multi-day continuous usage, improving reliability and satisfaction.
• Translated complex logistics functionality into intuitive, touch-friendly interfaces.

name: BeautyPass
tagline: A lifestyle platform connecting fashion models with businesses for mutual promotion.
description:
A lifestyle and influencer engagement platform connecting the world's largest community of fashion models with businesses for mutual promotion.

• Developed and optimized the React Native mobile app with a smooth, responsive, brand-aligned UI.
• Integrated RESTful APIs for product and service listings, member authentication, and real-time offers.
• Implemented social sharing to drive promotions via Instagram and other platforms.
• Reduced load times through code optimization and lazy loading.
• Collaborated with designers to build pixel-perfect, accessible, mobile-first layouts.

name: Noor · Soul Tracker
tagline: A spiritual wellness app that turns daily worship into a single soul score.
description:
A privacy-first iOS and Android app that helps users track their daily acts of worship and reflect on their spiritual progress in one place.

• A weighted soul score that blends prayers, Quran reading, Zikar, and Sadaqa into a single daily measure of effort.
• A Noor avatar with seven emotional states that respond to your actions and the time of day.
• Location-based prayer times using established Islamic calculation methods.
• A haptic Zikar counter, Quran progress tracking by page/Ayah/Juz, and charity logging.
• Full Apple Watch support with compass and complications, plus customizable daily streaks.
• On-device data with no account or server transmission — your practice stays private.
